rationale: Both candidates independently found the single most important confirmed-and-fixed ground-truth bug (varlen_func-None crash on masked path, matching RuixiangMa's comment) and the FA2/FA3 code-duplication issue, with grounded, actionable file:line citations. Y edges ahead on recall by also surfacing a well-reasoned, appropriately-hedged issue with the integer version= argument (touching the same confusion wtomin flagged about version=1/2/default) and noting the test's numerical-consistency claim is weakly verified plus FA3 being untested on the L4 hardware used in CI (sm_89 < sm_90). X's extra findings (missing except branch, comment wording, cross-file duplication) are valid but lower-value nitpicks that don't map to ground-truth concerns, so it doesn't close the recall gap despite being equally precise and actionable.
